_about: How CodeAi runs. To change something on this machine only, put just those keys in server/settings.local.json; it is never committed. The model list lives there too, since it holds this machine's folders.
_models: The models you can pick, first = the default. Each: id (short, no spaces), name (shown on the page), path (the model's folder; ~ is fine), note (shown under the picker), thinking (which thinking_levels it has), server_args (extra settings for mlx_lm's server, e.g. ["--kv-bits", "8"]).
_model_port: The model runs in its own program (mlx_lm's server) on this port, on this computer only.
_unload_after_minutes: Let go of the model when nothing has been asked for this long, so its memory is free. The next question then waits while it loads (20-60 seconds). 0 = as soon as the queue is empty.
_thinking_levels: The Thinking choices a model can have. A model lists the ones it understands in its own "thinking" (first = the default); with none, the page hides the choice. template: what the model's chat template is given.
_folders: Folders the model may look at (read only), each {name, path}. Set in settings.local.json, since they're this machine's paths.
_max_steps: Most times the model may use a tool (look at a folder, read a file...) for one question.
_max_tokens: Longest answer, thinking included, in tokens.
_memory: prompt_cache_size: past conversations the model server keeps ready (each takes memory; the model tests showed 10 can grow to over 100 GB). cache_gb: MLX's cache of freed memory.
_max_queue: Most questions waiting or being answered at once.
_backups_dir: A copy of every file the model changes, taken just before, so its answer can be undone.
